lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows and at least eight vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands of elevated intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a geometric grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light-reflective dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, irregular high-luminance points that contrast with the more structured, larger-blob pattern of the primary flank.
